description: This file defines a PHP class 'PurgeEmployeeModel' within the OrangeHRM project. The class models a data structure used for purging employees, encapsulating an employee number and providing a method to serialize this data into an array for API responses or further processing.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model representing the data required to purge an employee, primarily encapsulating the employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data into an associative array conforming to API schema.
